title: Lasted 6 months and just quit on me
text: Lasted 6 months and just quit on me. They worked good while I had them but I bought these last September and this is March 30 and they just quit on me one morning in the middle of making cookie dough.  I guess I should keep a back up around.  They just quit.  Will be ordering something else this time around.  The last pair of Osters with a 2500 watt motor lasted me 3 years, the beaters I had before that one belonged to my grandma for 30 years and I used it for 10 more years before it finally gave up the ghost.  I guess even the manufacturers know that this world is about to end and these things don't need to last.
